Traduzir necessidades entre negócio e tecnologia. Integrar aplicações, dados e processos com rastreabilidade.
Melhorar sistemas existentes com análise de impacto, documentação e cuidado com a continuidade da operação.

en.title: Felipe Macedo — Systems Analysis & Software Engineering
en.description: Systems Analyst at SANSUY. Investigation, integration and modernization of business-critical software. Projects, background and credentials.
headline: Understand complexity.
Build with clarity.
en.intro: I investigate systems, connect business needs to engineering decisions, and build solutions for operations that need to keep running.
en.valueIntro: Real systems have history, dependencies and people. The work starts with understanding what the next change must preserve.
values: Reconstruct business rules, trace dependencies and find the source of a problem before proposing a solution.
Translate needs between business and technology. Integrate applications, data and processes with traceable decisions.
Improve existing systems through impact analysis, documentation and care for operational continuity.
en.workTitle:
Systems that make
other systems clearer.
en.workIntro: Four investigations turned into software. Concrete problems, explicit decisions and documented limitations.
en.journeyTitle:
Engineering in the context
of the people using it.
en.job: In an industrial environment, I work across IT and business teams: application support, incident investigation, ERP evolution, integrations, and desktop and web development.
en.previous: Backend work on a financial authorization system related to Mastercard. Transaction processing deepened my interest in backend, distributed systems and reliability.
en.impact: A query in SANSUY’s engineering system took minutes. By investigating the problem and developing a solution aligned with the process, I brought the wait down to a nearly instant response — a noticeable change for the engineer responsible.
en.impactNote: Professional experience account. No published benchmark or internal business data.

en.badgesNote: Names and issuers preserved as published by Credly. Training badges are not presented as AWS certifications.
interests: Distributed systems, backend and architecture. Tools that help people develop and operate software.
Observability, integrations and gradual modernization. Cloud infrastructure grounded in actual system behavior.
AI-assisted engineering with review, tests and traceability. A tool should improve understanding of the problem.
